name: HC29a: Total Eligible
description:
Number of active ART patients who have reached routine viral load monitoring eligibility and are therefore expected to have a current VL within the preceding 12 months.
The patient must have a documented ART start date, must have reached at least six months on ART by :endDate, must be in HIV care, and must satisfy the active-on-ART rule through an ART encounter during the reporting period or return_visit_date > :endDate.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f

{
  "version": 1,
  "patientIdColumn": "patient_id",

  "redisaggregationStrategy": "population-extraction",

    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary",

FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
WHERE r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
      WHERE s.patient_id = r.patient_id
  )

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a

            (

            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT r.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
WHERE r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL

  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) <= :endDate

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
      WHERE s.patient_id = r.patient_id
  )

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = r.patient_id
        AND (
            (
                a.encounter_date >= :startDate
                AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
